<thought>The spectrum shows a classic carbon isotopic envelope: a strong monoisotopic peak, an M+1 peak at ~20 % intensity (consistent with ~18 carbons), and rapidly decreasing higher isotopes. No large M+2 peak characteristic of chlorine, bromine, or sulfur is present. Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
